title: more Coffee Delight
description: Coffee Delight Addon adds new coffee recipes for Farmer's Delight's cooking pot, featuring drinks like Arabic Coffee and Double Espresso with balanced crafting mechanics.
body:
The Coffee Delight Addon datapack seamlessly expands Farmer's Delight's cooking pot system with specialized coffee recipes, including Arabic Coffee, Double Espresso, and handcrafted chocolate beverages. Each recipe maintains authentic brewing mechanics with precise cooking durations and container return systems, delivering an immersive culinary experience that perfectly integrates with both Coffee Delight and Farmer's Delight mods.If you want to use mods,you can gao [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/coffee-delight-addon-mods)。

Coffee Delight 扩展数据包为农夫乐事的厨锅系统新增了专业咖啡配方，包括阿拉伯咖啡、双倍浓缩咖啡和手工巧克力饮品。每个配方均采用真实的酿造机制，包含精确的烹饪时长和容器回收系统，在与Coffee Delight和农夫乐事模组的完美兼容中提供沉浸式烹饪体验。如果想用模组版，请移步[这里](https://modrinth.com/mod/coffee-delight-addon-mods)
